name: git-workflows
description: Isolate task worktrees and write useful changelogs, reviewable commits and pull requests with verified context and repository privacy.

interface.shortDescription: Task worktrees, useful changelogs and reviewable Git changes.
interface.longDescription: Keep tasks in their own worktrees and changelogs current before handoff. Resume the right workspace, preserve unfinished work, and write reviewable commits and pull requests.
defaultPrompt: Commit the intended changes as small, reviewable commits.
Write and save a pull request for the completed change.
Prepare or resume the worktree for this repository task.
